answer: The protocol places each new agent on a knoll‑indexed stake and requires it to submit a signed whisper token that references a randomly chosen bridge node from the current jury pool. Every epoch a subset of jurors is drawn, the bridge node cross‑checks the whisper against its own ledger and any mismatch triggers an on‑chain audit that burns the challenger’s stake. An attacker must lock up and forfeit 10 % of the token value per fabricated identity, plus wait a 48‑hour cooling period before any vote counts, making a thousand Sybils cost at least ten‑thousand tokens.
